title: Word rotator
description: A line of text where one word cycles through a list: a slot column that scrolls with the neighbours fading above and below, or words that flip in and out. The line re-centres as the word's width changes; on vertical frames prefix, word and suffix stack. For taglines and end cards ("Made for *storytellers*").

prefix.description: Text before the rotating word (empty: none).

words.description: The words, in order; the last one stays.

suffix.description: Text after the rotating word (empty: none).

style.description: slot: a scrolling column with faded neighbours; flip: each word rolls up and out; auto: slot on landscape, flip on vertical (where the line is stacked).

size.description: Font size, px at 1080. 0 (default): 120 (150 when stacked), smaller if the line would overflow the safe width; so 120 looks like the default, go to 160-220 for a bigger line. A size you set is used as is, even past the safe width.
